description.value:
Artificer engineers treat the lightsaber not merely as a weapon but as a puzzle in living crystal. By coaxing new properties from kyber and its housing, they refine a blade until its hum carries a signature all their own, and in the process they brush against the same current of the Force that gives every lightsaber its life.

That closeness to the crystal opens a door few other engineers ever find: fragments of true Force training seep into their work, letting them wield a handful of powers alongside their bladework. The result is a duelist as comfortable bending the Force as bending metal.
